caption: The drawing depicts a single dark-colored vessel, resembling a mug or a small pot, positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The vessel is dark brown to black in color, with a large, rounded handle attached on the left side. The vessel stands on three small, stubby legs that are lighter in color, hinting at a ceramic or earthenware material. The body of the vessel is decorated with a pattern of wavy parallel lines that run horizontally, intersected by evenly spaced, small circular dots arranged in rows. The rim is wide and thick, with subtle shading indicating its curved form. The artist's signature, "R. Stewart," appears below and slightly to the right of the vessel.
title: Pa. German Cheese Strainer
